messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick checkin 1: CloudScale wants simultaneous marketplace listing + Redwood landing on go-live. Ops window?
Mike Chen: Ops prefers 09:00-11:00 UTC (EU/US overlap). @Priya ok for partner?
Priya (CloudScale): 09:00-11:00 UTC works. Embargo lift at 08:40 UTC please so press can schedule.
Julie Park: Design needs hero + 2 screenshots by EOD tomorrow. Mike, where will assets land?
Mike Chen: Uploading to drive by 18:00 PT: https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/cloudscale/assets
Tom Reilly: Draft launch run (short):
```
07:00 UTC - infra preflight
07:30 UTC - readiness huddle
08:30 UTC - CDN prewarm, DNS TTL reduce
08:40 UTC - embargo lift
09:00 UTC - publish landing + marketplace entry
09:05 UTC - smoke tests + telemetry
```
Ana Rivera: SI note: EdgeWorks needs test tenant + rotated API keys before 07:30 UTC. Tom pls confirm.
Tom Reilly: Confirmed. Provisioning complete by 07:00 UTC; will paste logs.
Mike Chen: Rollback snippet for runbook:
```
1) point /partners/cloudscale -> hold page
2) call POST /v1/private/listings/{id}/revert
3) post status to #partners and escalate
```
Julie Park: I'll own blog finalization & partner quote (Priya to send 1-2 lines by 17:00 PT).
Priya (CloudScale): Quote incoming by 17:00 PT. We'll staff 08:30-10:30 UTC for verification.
Mike Chen: Launch coverage needed: 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM for 09:00-11:00 UTC. Volunteers?
Tom Reilly: I'll do infra primary 07:30-09:30 UTC then handoff.
Julie Park: Comms 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Ana Rivera: I'll post go/no-go at 06:00 UTC day-of. :rocket:
LaunchBot: Reminder set: "Pre-launch health check" 07:10 UTC -> #ops-bridge
Ana Rivera: Final blockers? Legal clearance on embargo?
Julie Park: Legal already cleared yesterday. I'll CC them on publish thread.
Priya (CloudScale): Partner checklist green aside from quote. Standing by.
Mike Chen: Actions: Julie finalize blog + quote, Mike update runbook & calendar, Tom pre-provision + CDN, Priya deliver quote.
